title: 7. Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate Tribunal (TDSAT)

blocks.content: TDSAT was established in 2000 to adjudicate disputes between telecom operators, consumers, and the government. It also hears appeals against TRAI decisions.
TDSAT was established in 2000 to adjudicate disputes between telecom operators, consumers, and the government.

items: Appeals against TRAI decisions lie before TDSAT, not directly before regular civil courts.
TDSAT was set up in 2000 to handle tripartite disputes involving consumers, operators, and the government.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: TDSAT was established in the year 2000.
It resolves disputes among telecom operators, consumers, and the government.
It functions as the appellate body for decisions taken by TRAI.
